contexts.text: Their eyes were opened = that they Knew and acknowledged from an interior dictate... AC 212. Illustrated.

The voice of Jehovah God... in the garden = a dictate which they feared. The dictate is the residue of perception which they had... To hide themselves from the face of Jehovah God = to fear the dictate, as they are wont to do who are conscious of evil. AC 222.
As with the regenerate, who have a dictate.
Mercy, peace, all good, or the faces of Jehovah, are what cause the dictate with those who have perception; even with those who have conscience...
Whence come perception, dictate, and conscience. Explained... It is this combat which is felt through perception, dictate, and conscience...
Jehovah said to Cain = that conscience dictated.

There then succeeded conscience, which also dictates, but in a different manner. When conscience dictates, it is in like manner said that Jehovah speaks... for when the Word says or dictates, it is the Lord Who says it.
Conscience... dictates, not what is the truth, but that it is the truth...
A reproof by the Spirit of Jehovah = an internal dictate, perception or conscience.
The Ancient Church had not perception, but in its stead a certain other dictate, which may be called conscience.

Man could no longer have a like perception, but in place of perception a certain other dictate, which may be called conscience; for it was similar to conscience, although it was a kind of intermediate between perception and the conscience known to some at this day.
They who have conscience, from conscience have a certain dictate; but no other than that it is true because they have so heard and learned...
There is something within which dictates; for such (a dictate) flows in from the Lord through the Angels who are with every man.
When manifest experience dictates.
They who become spiritual men... have an analogue of perception, or else a dictate of conscience, more or less...
Every internal dictate is nothing else (than internal speech).

Between the parts = that with man which is called perception, internal dictate, and conscience; the things which are above perception, internal dictate, and conscience are the Lord's; those which are below, are with man.
The Lord's perception... dictated to Him how the case was... With the celestial man (too), who has perception, there is a certain truth adjoined to good which dictates...
Conscience is a certain general dictate, thus an obscure one, of those things which flow in through the Heavens from the Lord...
That which is dictated to them by the Lord through conscience...
In themselves, reflection and perception are internal indication and dictation.
Everything that is said in the Word through the prophets and others, the Angels dictating, is from the Lord.
There flows in through the Rational as it were a dictate that this is true, and that this is not true...
To the interiors of the ear belong those who... obey what its Spirit dictates there, and bring forth his dictates fittingly.

He who teaches faith and not charity... has not anything which leads, and which dictates whether this is of faith, or whether this is true; whereas if he teaches charity, he then has good, and this is a dictate to him...
External men... have no dictate within.

He supposes that it is implanted in him, and that it flows from the connection of the things; whereas it is a dictate through Heaven from the Lord into the interiors of the thought, which flows in concerning such things as are above what is natural and sensuous...
When a man recedes from good, and feels any anxiety, it is not from any innate dictate, but from the faith he has imbibed from infancy; this then dictates and causes that anxiety.
The internal sense... has been dictated to me from Heaven.
The prophets, through whom the Word was written, wrote as the Spirit from the Divine dictated; the very words which they wrote were uttered in their ears.
To consult as to what the Divine dictates. Signified.
Inspiration is not dictation, but is influx from the Divine...
Divine answers are presented in ultimates; for they pass through all interior things in succession, and are there dictated, because there they cease.

A like explendescence is inwardly presented with those who are in truths from good, which dictates and as it were gives answers, when truth is inquired into from the affection of the heart, and is loved as good.

The Lord spoke to the prophets through Spirits who were sent to them, whom the Lord filled with His aspect, and thus inspired the words which they dictated to the prophets; so that there was not influx, but dictate.
The Word... has been dictated by the Lord; and that which is dictated by the Lord passes through all the Heavens in order, and is terminated with man.
Conscience is an internal dictate... References.
The things in the Doctrine of the New Jerusalem... are orally dictated by angelic Spirits to the (Africans).
There is a spiritual idea... which flows in with those who are in the affection of truth, and interiorly dictates...
Every man as to his spirit... is in spiritual light, which enlightens the interiors of his understanding, and as it were dictates.
The Word, which has been dictated by the Lord...
This holy Book has been dictated by Jehovah the Lord...
They think from as it were a certain dictate inwardly in them... It is said from dictate, etc., and it is meant, from the Divine Providence.
The whole of the Holy Scripture... was dictated by God.
From the Divine influx into the souls of men it follows, that there is an internal dictate with every man that there is a God, and that He is one.
Because it has been asserted by a man of authority...
For the Word was dictated by Jehovah Himself, and what is dictated by Jehovah is purely the Divine truth.
Among whom was that dictator... Then that dictator...
Reason itself... dictates.
The students write down from the lips of the teachers in the seminaries their dicta.
These things have been more clearly delivered from Heaven, although not dictated, as I could clearly perceive.
I have not been allowed to insert anything whatever that was dictated by them viva voce.
This state came to me, when I could not write anything with clearness except those things which were as it were tacitly dictated to me.
The things above written were inspired to me by an Angel... the words came spontaneously into the paper, but without dictation.
It was dictated, but in a wonderful way, into the thought.
These papers (written by means of the hand being led) were destroyed... nor is it permitted to dictate anything viva voce.
Occurs.
a. If Angels were to dictate words...
There was one who continually asserted...
The prophets, to whom the several words were dictated.
The man is led and taught, not immediately, through any dictate...
The holiness of the dictates of the Pope...
Some things were then dictated to (Melancthon) by Angels from Heaven...
